snippet.title: Strato Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer for the upcoming game 'Strato' by Reject Games.

'Strato' is an arcadey aerial combat timed survival game.

Kickstarter campaign to be announced soon!

Wish-list on Steam here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4823770/Strato/
